title: Danish Government Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at UCPH. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.
funding_details: Tuition fee reduction and/or living stipend (amount varies by faculty). Exact funding level determined by faculty based on academic merit.

funding_details: Tuition fee reduction and/or living stipend (amount varies by faculty). Exact funding level determined by faculty based on academic merit.

title: Tuition Fee Waiver
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's or PhD programme at DTU. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.
funding_details: Full or partial tuition fee waiver. Does not cover living expenses, travel, or accommodation.

title: International Student Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at AAU. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver + DKK 9,960/month living stipend (approx. EUR 1,330) for the duration of the Master's programme. Taxed in Denmark.
